result.summary: Added 7 public BFF routes for the single-import lifecycle, extended SchedulingClient, updated PUBLIC_API_V1.md, and added a skip-declared BFF integration test suite.
result.report:
Exposed the seven internal `/internal/calendar/imports/*` routes from WU-08 as public BFF routes under `/v1/calendar/imports/*`: start, analyze, list items (paginated), item decision, execute, progress, complete. All use `{ preHandler: requireTenantContext }` (tenant/user always from session, CSRF-by-cookie enforced by the existing global auth flow) and none accept `source`, `target`, `tenantId`, or `userId` in the body — zod strips unknown keys, and internalContext(request) always derives tenant/actor from the session, same pattern as the existing calendar/routes.ts.

Changes:
- `apps/bff/src/clients/scheduling/index.ts`: added zod response schemas for the import lifecycle (session, item, decision, preview summary, items page, execution result, progress, completion result) and 7 new SchedulingClient methods (startImport, analyzeImport, listImportItems, decideImportItem, executeImport, importProgress, completeImport), each forwarding Idempotency-Key where the internal route requires it.
- `apps/bff/src/modules/migrations/routes.ts`: added zod body/params/query schemas mirroring the scheduling-service's, registered the 7 routes, and added a local `idempotencyKey()` helper (matches the one in calendar/routes.ts, throwing `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400 when missing).
- `apps/bff/PUBLIC_API_V1.md`: replaced the "Migração bidirecional" row in "Contratos legados ainda ativos" with a note that the legacy protocol has no frontend consumer post-Goal010, added a new "Importação única (Goal010)" row to the main route inventory table, and added a full "## Importação única do Minha Agenda (Goal010)" section documenting all 7 routes, the human-only/no-source-switch constraint, and the "one import per business" error behavior (`IMPORT_ALREADY_COMPLETED`, `IMPORT_ITEM_ALREADY_DECIDED`).
- `apps/bff/tests/goal010-import-routes.integration.test.ts` (new): integration suite modeled on `goal009-calendar-routes.integration.test.ts` — real session/CSRF against a stubbed Scheduling fetch. Covers: tenant resolved from session while header/body/query tenant attempts are ignored and never reach upstream; all 7 operations exercised end-to-end with correct Idempotency-Key forwarding; CSRF rejection before any upstream call for every mutating route; missing-Idempotency-Key rejection before any upstream call; and an upstream `IMPORT_ALREADY_COMPLETED` error passed through as `UPSTREAM_ERROR` with no leaked credentials/infra detail. Gated by `RUN_INTEGRATION` (skip declared, same as existing suites) since no disposable DB is available in this environment.

Commands actually run (from `apps/bff`): `npm run typecheck` (passes, prisma generate + tsc --noEmit, 0 errors), `npm run lint` (eslint src, 0 errors), `npx vitest run tests/goal010-import-routes.integration.test.ts` (1 file skipped, 5 tests skipped — no DB configured), `npx vitest run` (full suite: 7 files skipped, 52 tests skipped, no regressions). Could not execute the suite against a real database (no docker/postgres available in this environment), so the runtime behavior of the new routes is unverified beyond typecheck/lint/structural compile — this matches the same limitation already present for every other BFF integration suite in this worktree.

acceptance.criterion: Cada operação de importação tem rota pública equivalente no BFF, com tenant derivado da sessão e CSRF por cookie
acceptance.detail: 7 routes registered in apps/bff/src/modules/migrations/routes.ts (lines 144-275): POST /v1/calendar/imports, POST .../analyze, GET .../categories/:category/items, POST .../items/:itemId/decision, POST .../execute, GET .../progress, POST .../complete — all with preHandler: requireTenantContext, which resolves tenant from session and enforces CSRF for cookie auth via requireAuth (lib/auth.ts).

acceptance.criterion: Tenant não é selecionável por header, body ou query: a tentativa é recusada, provada por teste
acceptance.detail: internalContext(request) always derives tenantId/userId from currentTenantContext(request), ignoring any body/query field (zod schemas don't declare tenantId/userId, so extras are stripped). Proven in goal010-import-routes.integration.test.ts first test (tenantId sent via query/body/header, upstream call carries owner's tenantId, not other's).

acceptance.criterion: Nenhuma rota expõe fonte remota como opção vigente nem oferece troca de fonte ou sincronização
acceptance.detail: No body/query schema in the new routes accepts source or target; startImportBodySchema only takes sourceAccountId/sourceAccountLabel/replace, matching the scheduling-service's contract where the origin is always the already-connected Minha Agenda integration. Test asserts forwarded.source and forwarded.target are undefined.

acceptance.criterion: PUBLIC_API_V1.md está atualizado e a linha 'Migração bidirecional' foi substituída pelo contrato de importação única
acceptance.detail: apps/bff/PUBLIC_API_V1.md: added 'Importação única (Goal010)' row to the main table, renamed the 'Migração bidirecional' legacy row, and added a full '## Importação única do Minha Agenda (Goal010)' section documenting all 7 routes and constraints.

acceptance.criterion: Testes de integração do BFF cobrem as rotas novas, com skip declarado quando não houver banco
acceptance.detail: apps/bff/tests/goal010-import-routes.integration.test.ts, gated by describe.skipIf(!RUN_INTEGRATION), same pattern as existing suites; verified it compiles and skips cleanly via npx vitest run (no DB available in this environment).

acceptance.criterion: Erros do Scheduling chegam ao cliente sem vazar detalhe de infraestrutura, segredo ou payload cru de origem
acceptance.detail: Uses the existing InternalHttpClient error normalization (UPSTREAM_ERROR wrapping upstreamCode/upstreamDetails only), unchanged by this WU. Test asserts a stubbed IMPORT_ALREADY_COMPLETED error surfaces as UPSTREAM_ERROR with only sessionId/completedAt in details, and the full response body contains no basicAuth/password/authorization strings.
